title: A Double-blind, Double-dummy, Parallel, Active-controlled, Randomized Trial to Evaluate Efficacy & Safety in Anemia Subjects
brief_summary: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of 12 weeks treatment with Ferrous (II) Glycine Sulphate Complex in comparison to Polyferose capsules in Chinese subjects with manifest Iron Deficiency Anemia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* An iron deficiency anemia patient with Serum Ferritin \< 12 ng/mL, serum Hb-values \>60 and \< 120 g/L in males, \< 110 g/L in females

Exclusion Criteria:

* With any Mal-absorption Syndrome
* With a history of Thalassemia or Sickle Cell Anemia
* With untreated concurrent Vitamin B12 or Folate deficiency at Baseline
